implemented: For 15 verified zero-altitude ground families, raw object X=model X-30 and row Y=Board.GetPosYBasedOnRow(model X+10,row)-30. Pool rows, mini zombies, rises, vaults, flights and unmapped families retain their previous bridge.
Pult aim Y uses the integer native body top, including giant -38 and vehicle -13 rectangle offsets; boss aim Y uses GridToPixelY(8,row).
Lob collision and melon splash use native integer body X plus species rectangle offsets, including reversed body rectangles and giant object width 180.
Target lead uses the integer body rectangle center, matching source integer division, before fifty- or thirty-tick speed prediction. Unsupported states retain their previous prediction anchor.
Mapped ground renders use source fractional object position, species image offsets, source (15,-8) root, native scale and mirrored +90 translation.
Actor and giant pose caches include native-root mode, so same-clock root changes are applied and death clips keep the correct root without new display parts.
testFixtureChanges: Three existing lob fixtures assumed zombie X was its body center. Their projectile/target positions were replaced with explicit native rectangle boundaries while retaining original damage, timing, wide-body and rear-exclusion assertions.
Existing lead and squash expectations now use source integer body centers; no price, cooldown, health, wave, seed or player strategy was changed.
remaining: Water, dolphin, snorkel, pogo, balloon, digger, dance direction, mini, rising and thrown-state altitude/clipping/root mappings.
The +30 coordinate bridge is retained; species-specific original spawn positions and phase transitions are not yet fully ported.
Ordinary pea/star/bite/squash attack rectangles and other effects still use legacy approximations and must be mapped consistently.
Boss contact/collision and full stage completion still require verification; the current boss ordinary-play test fails.
Complete 1:1 art, sound, gameplay and real iOS/Android behavior remain unproven.
